user.title: Full Power EV Charger
user.description: Enter your Full Power / Kiso app credentials

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Full Power
reauth_confirm.description: Your saved password for {username} was rejected. Enter it again.

error.no_devices: No chargers found on this account

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: Poll fast only while a charge started by Home Assistant is active; otherwise check in slowly.

data.stale_minutes: Treat charger as offline after (minutes with no device report)
data.capture_enabled: Capture raw cloud payloads to disk (developer diagnostics; off by default)

set_delayed_charge.name: Set delayed / timed charge
set_delayed_charge.description: Schedule a delayed start and/or charge duration.

mac.name: Charger MAC
mac.description: MAC of the charger as shown on the device in Home Assistant.

time.name: Start time
time.description: Scheduled clock start time, e.g. 22:30. Leave blank to use countdown.

charge_duration.name: Charge duration
charge_duration.description: How long to charge once started, in seconds. 0 = no limit.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.description: Seconds from now until charging starts. 0 = immediate, or use start time.
